title: Get in, loser: Broadway's newest 'Mean Girls' are ready to insult (and enlighten) you
summary: "School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play," is ending a Broadway run this week and celebrating with livestream broadcasts. We interviewed the Tony-nominated playwright, Jocelyn Bioh.
contentText:
School Girls; Or the African Mean Girls Play during opening night curtain call for the play's Broadway run this fall. In this final week of performances, livestreaming is available. Left to right: Nia Otchere-Sarfo, Jordan Rice, Lucia Aremu, Denee Benton, Heather Alicia Simms, Erin Morton, Jasmine Amy Rogers and Patina Miller.'/> "School Girls; Or, The African Mean Girls Play," is ending a Broadway run this week and celebrating with livestream broadcasts. We interviewed the Tony-nominated playwright, Jocelyn Bioh.
